manifest.name: YouTube Tweak - Boost Your YouTube Experience
manifest.description: Packed with all the features you want: lock quality, speed buttons, show comments name and translate, hide distractions, and more.
manifest.description_apple: Enhance video websites with quality lock, speed buttons, comment tools, and cleaner pages.

reloadNotice.chromeApiOffline: $APP_NAME$ has been updated. Reload this page to apply the update.
reloadNotice.onToggle: Reload YouTube to apply this setting.

checkbox.enable: Automatically switch to this quality when playback starts

tips.quality: If the selected quality is not available, the highest lower quality will be used.

tips.slider: When enabled, drag left or right for continuous speed; the mouse wheel uses the selected wheel step.

checkbox.saveByChannel: Remember subtitle on/off status per channel

checkbox.hideCeElement: Translucent the recommended videos/authors at the end of videos
checkbox.progressEnable: Show the progress bar below the video
checkbox.progressEnableTag: Show the video time in the corner

checkbox.nonStop: Disable automatic video pausing (prompt: "Video paused. Continue watching?")

checkbox.showControl: Show booster control beside the speed strip

tips.control: Adds a real gain stage above YouTube's built-in 100% volume. Use the in-player button to toggle it instantly.

tips.enable: Use the mouse wheel over the video to zoom. After zooming in, drag the video to move the view.

checkbox.enable: Keep playing in a floating mini-player while scrolling

tips.enable: Float the current video while you scroll. Dismiss it from the player anytime.

checkbox.showManualTranslateButtonForSkippedLangu: Show a manual translation button for comments that do not need automatic translation
checkbox.lineByLineTranslate: Place translations under each original line

select.neverTranslate: Never translate these languages (Ctrl to multi-select)

checkbox.videoPerRow: Lock number of videos per row

tips.enable: Experimental feature (unstable). In some cases, you still need to click "Skip" additionally in the player, and it may be detected by YouTube.
tips.videoDeprecated: The video ad blocking feature is no longer available. We recommend the following extensions:
tips.uBlockOrigin: General-purpose ad blocker that also blocks video ads
tips.sponsorBlock: Blocks sponsored segments embedded in videos

checkbox.enableWatch: Block Shorts on video watch page

tips.inject: Applies to youtube.com pages after the textarea loses focus.

global.name: Global
global.description: This video can be viewed in all countries/regions.

family.name: Family Friendly
family.description: This video is suitable for all ages.

login.name: Login Required
login.description: Whether a login is required to watch this video.

blocked.name: Blocked
blocked.description: This video cannot be played due to issues such as copyright infringement.

r18.name: Age Restricted
r18.description: This video is for adults only.

kids.name: Kids Content
kids.description: This video is for children and cannot be commented on, watched in a mini player, or played in the background.

membership.name: Members Only
membership.description: This video is only available to paid channel members.

shorts.name: Allow Shorts
shorts.description: Allows this video to be used in YouTube Shorts.

embed.name: Embed
embed.description: Whether this video can be embedded on other sites.

crawlable.name: Unlisted
crawlable.description: This video can only be viewed by those with the link. It will not appear on the channel page and cannot be indexed by search engines.

private.name: Private
private.description: This video is only visible to the uploader or those invited by the uploader.

tips.title: ⚠ Warning
tips.fetchHooker: Some features (such as bilingual subtitles, blocking video ads, and spoofing the Premium logo) use HTTP request rewriting and may cause page issues. This is especially relevant to payment-related features (such as purchasing Premium, joining a channel membership, or making live-stream donations). If you encounter problems while browsing these pages, try disabling this feature.

tips.title: 💖 If you like this extension, consider sponsoring it
tips.description: Every sponsorship is vital support for keeping this extension in active development, fixing issues, adapting to YouTube's frequent changes, and continuously polishing the small details.
